items.source: Indicate whether IllegalArgumentException and AspectJAdviceParameterNameDiscoverer.AmbiguousBindingException must be thrown as appropriate in the case of failing to deduce advice parameter names.
items.translation: 指明在无法推导出建议参数名称的情况下，是否应适当抛出 IllegalArgumentException 和 AspectJAdviceParameterNameDiscoverer.AmbiguousBindingException。

items.source: The behavior on raising an IllegalArgumentException or AmbiguousBindingException is configurable to allow this discoverer to be used as part of a chain-of-responsibility. By default the condition will be logged and the getParameterNames(Method) method will simply return null. If the raiseExceptions property is set to true, the conditions will be thrown as IllegalArgumentException and AmbiguousBindingException, respectively.
items.translation: 抛出 `IllegalArgumentException` 或 `AmbiguousBindingException` 的行为是可配置的，以便将此发现器用作责任链的一部分。默认情况下，该条件将被记录，且 `getParameterNames(Method)` 方法将简单地返回 `null`。如果将 `raiseExceptions` 属性设置为 `true`，则条件将分别作为 `IllegalArgumentException` 和 `AmbiguousBindingException` 抛出。

items.source: If an unambiguous binding can be deduced, then it is. If the advice requirements cannot possibly be satisfied, then null is returned. By setting the raiseExceptions property to true, descriptive exceptions will be thrown instead of returning null in the case that the parameter names cannot be discovered.
items.translation: 如果可以推导出无歧义的结合，那么就会进行结合。如果建议要求不可能满足，则返回 `null`。通过将 `raiseExceptions` 属性设置为 `true`，在无法发现参数名称的情况下，将抛出描述性异常而不是返回 `null`。

items.source: If afterReturning advice binds the return value, the returning variable name must be specified.
items.translation: 如果 `afterReturning` 建议绑定返回值，则必须指定 `returning` 变量名。

items.translation: 如果 `afterThrowing` 建议绑定抛出的值，则必须指定 `throwing` 变量名。

Create a new discoverer that attempts to discover parameter names.
from the given pointcut expression.
items.translation: 创建一个新的发现器，尝试从给定的切入点表达式中查找参数名称。

items.source: If there remain unbound arguments, then the pointcut expression is examined once more for this, target, and args pointcut expressions used in the binding form (binding forms are deduced as described for the annotation based pointcuts). If there remains more than one unbound argument of a primitive type (which can only be bound in args) then an AmbiguousBindingException is raised. If there is exactly one argument of a primitive type, then if exactly one args bound variable was found, we assign the corresponding parameter name the variable name. If there were no args bound variables found an IllegalStateException is raised. If there are multiple args bound variables, an AmbiguousBindingException is raised. At this point, if there remains more than one unbound argument we raise an AmbiguousBindingException. If there are no unbound arguments remaining, we are done. If there is exactly one unbound argument remaining, and only one candidate variable name unbound from this, target, or args, it is assigned as the corresponding parameter name. If there are multiple possibilities, an AmbiguousBindingException is raised.
items.translation: 如果仍有未绑定的参数，则再次检查点切面表达式中用于绑定形式的 `this`、`target` 和 `args` 点切面表达式（绑定形式如基于注解的点切面所述进行推导）。如果剩余多个基本类型的未绑定参数（这些只能由 `args` 绑定），则抛出 `AmbiguousBindingException`。如果恰好有一个基本类型参数，且发现恰好一个 `args` 绑定变量，则将对应的参数名赋为该变量名。如果没有找到 `args` 绑定变量，则抛出 `IllegalStateException`。如果存在多个 `args` 绑定变量，则抛出 `AmbiguousBindingException`。此时，如果仍有多个未绑定参数，则抛出 `AmbiguousBindingException`。如果没有剩余未绑定参数，则完成。如果恰好剩余一个未绑定参数，且仅有一个候选变量名未从 `this`、`target` 或 `args` 中解绑，则将其赋为对应的参数名。如果存在多个可能性，则抛出 `AmbiguousBindingException`。

items.source: If a throwingName has been set, and there are no unbound arguments of type Throwable+, then an IllegalArgumentException is raised. If there is more than one unbound argument of type Throwable+, then an AspectJAdviceParameterNameDiscoverer.AmbiguousBindingException is raised. If there is exactly one unbound argument of type Throwable+, then the corresponding parameter name is assigned the value <throwingName>.
items.translation: 如果已设置 `throwingName`，且没有类型为 `Throwable+` 的未绑定参数，则会抛出 IllegalArgumentException。如果有多个类型为 `Throwable+` 的未绑定参数，则会抛出 AspectJAdviceParameterNameDiscoverer.AmbiguousBindingException。如果恰好有一个类型为 `Throwable+` 的未绑定参数，则将其对应的参数名赋值为 <throwingName>。

items.source: If there remain unbound arguments, then the pointcut expression is examined. Let a be the number of annotation-based pointcut expressions (@annotation, @this, @target, @args, @within, @withincode) that are used in binding form. Usage in binding form has itself to be deduced: if the expression inside the pointcut is a single string literal that meets Java variable name conventions it is assumed to be a variable name. If a is zero we proceed to the next stage. If a > 1 then an AmbiguousBindingException is raised. If a == 1, and there are no unbound arguments of type Annotation+, then an IllegalArgumentException is raised. If there is exactly one such argument, then the corresponding parameter name is assigned the value from the pointcut expression.
items.translation: 如果仍有未绑定的参数，则检查点切面表达式。设 `a` 为在绑定形式中使用的基于注解的点切面表达式（@annotation、@this、@target、@args、@within、@withincode）的数量。在绑定形式中的使用本身需要推断：如果点切面内部的表达式是一个符合 Java 变量命名约定的单个字符串字面量，则假定其为变量名。如果 `a` 为零，则进入下一阶段。如果 `a` > 1，则抛出 AmbiguousBindingException。如果 `a` == 1，且没有类型为 Annotation+ 的未绑定参数，则抛出 IllegalArgumentException。如果恰好有一个此类参数，则将对应的参数名赋值为点切面表达式中的值。

items.translation: UnsupportedOperationException - 如果 raiseExceptions 已设置为 true

items.source: If the first parameter of the method is of type JoinPoint or ProceedingJoinPoint, it is assumed to be for passing thisJoinPoint to the advice, and the parameter name will be assigned the value "thisJoinPoint".

items.source: If a returningName has been set, and there are no unbound arguments then an IllegalArgumentException is raised. If there is more than one unbound argument then an AmbiguousBindingException is raised. If there is exactly one unbound argument then the corresponding parameter name is assigned the value of the returningName.
items.translation: 如果已设置 `returningName` 且没有未绑定的参数，则抛出 `IllegalArgumentException`》。如果有多个未绑定参数，则抛出 `AmbiguousBindingException`。如果恰好有一个未绑定参数，则将对应的参数名赋值为 `returningName` 的值。
